title: The background-state skill imports two functions the SDK does not export
claim: The official background-state skill tells agents to import setBackgroundState and onBackgroundRestore from @evenrealities/even_hub_sdk. The SDK's published type definitions declare neither.
actual: Neither function is in the published SDK. A July report found both missing from 0.0.10 and 0.0.11. Version 0.0.16, the current release, has neither in dist/index.d.ts or dist/index.js. TypeScript rejects the import, and a bundler or browser fails on a named import the module does not export.
impact: An agent that applies the skill produces an app that does not build. Removing the calls leaves the app with no state persistence.
workaround: Do not apply the skill. Save state with bridge.setLocalStorage and restore it on launch.

evidence.note: Checked the published dist/index.d.ts and index.js of 0.0.10 and 0.0.11.
The module has 69 exports; neither function is one of them. The skill on main still imports both as of 2026-11-17.
